subject: math

objective.text: Use square tiles to decompose a rectangle.

explanations.title: Decompose a rectangle
explanations.text: To decompose a rectangle, split it into two smaller rectangles. Use a ruler to split it with a line. The two parts are rectangles too.

explanations.title: Number bond for a rectangle
explanations.text: Write the whole rectangle at the top, like 4 rows of 5. Write the two parts below it, like 2 rows of 5 and 2 rows of 5.

explanations.title: Number sentence for each part
explanations.text: The whole has a repeated addition sentence. Each part has its own. 5 plus 5 plus 5 plus 5 is the whole. 5 plus 5 equals 10 is one part.

explanations.title: Remove a row or a column
explanations.text: Take away a row and the total goes down by the size of a row. Take away a column and the total goes down by the size of a column.

explanations.title: Make the next ten to add
explanations.text: 9 plus 4 is the same as 10 plus 3. Take 1 from the 4 and give it to the 9.

examples.title: 16 tiles, remove a row and a column
examples.text: 4 rows of 4 is 16. Take away a row: 3 rows of 4 is 12. Take away a column: 3 rows of 3 is 9.
